question:
The radius of a spherical balloon is inflated from 3.5 cm to 4.9 cm by pushing air into it. What is the percentage increase in the volume of the original balloon?

(CGL MAINS 2020)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 174.4%.

initial radius r1 = 3.5 

increase radius = r2 = 4.9 

increament in ratio (r) = \(\frac{3.5}{4.9}\) = \(\frac{5}{7}\) 

Volume of sphere = \(\frac{4}{3}\) \(\pi\)r3

Volume: \(\alpha\) ×r3 

increment in ratio ( Vol .) = \(\frac{125}{343}\)

% increase in volume = \(\left(\frac{343\ -\ 125}{125}\right)\) \(\times\) 100 = 174.4%

question:
A solid metallic sphere of radius 4 cm is melted and recast into spheres of 2 cm each. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original sphere to the sum of surface areas of the spheres, so formed?

(CGL MAINS 2020)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 1:2.

Make volume equal 
Let, no. of sphere formed = n 
\(\frac{4}{3}\) \(\pi\) R3 = n \(\times\) \(\frac{4}{3}\) \(\pi\)r3 
64 = n \(\times\) 8  \(\Rightarrow\) n = 8 
Required ratio =  \(​ \frac{4R^2}{8\times \ 4r^2} ​\) = \(​ \frac{R^2}{8\  r^2} ​\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(​ \frac{16}{8\ \times \ 4} ​\) = 1 : 2

question:
The total surface area of a right pyramid, with base as a square of side 8 cm, is 208 cm². What is the slant height (in cm) of the pyramid?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 9.

TSA of pyramid =
\(\frac{1}{2}\) \(\times\) Base Perimeter \(\times\) Slant Height + Base Area
\(\frac{1}{2}\) \(\times\) 32 \(\times\) S.H + 64 = 208 
\(\frac{1}{2}\) \(\times\) 32 \(\times\) S.H = 208 - 64 = 144 
Slant Height = \(\frac{144}{16}\) = 9 cm

question:
The base of a right prism is an equilateral triangle whose side is 10 cm. If height of this prism is \(10\sqrt3\) cm, then what is the total surface area of prism?

(CGL MAINS 2020)
options:

\(325\sqrt3\) cm2

\(150\sqrt3\) cm2

\(350\sqrt3 \) cm2
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. \(350\sqrt3 \) cm2.

Total surface area of prism = CSA + 2 \(\times\) Base Area

= 20 \(\times\) \(10\sqrt3\) + \(2\times\frac{\sqrt3}{4}\) \(\times\) 10 \(\times\) 10 
= \(300\sqrt3\) + \(50\sqrt3\)
= \(350\sqrt3\) cm2

Area door (d) = 8 × 3.5 
⇒ d = 28 ft2 
Area of 2 windows(w) = 2 × 5 × 3
⇒ w = 30 ft2
Area to be painted = x + y - d - w 
= 540 + 180 - 28 - 30 = 662 ft2 
Cost of painting = 662 × 50= ₹33,100
question_hi:

⇒ w = 30 फीट2

= 540 + 180 - 28 - 30 = 662 फीट2

question:
Two wires of lengths 10 m 54 cm and 11 m 56 cm are both cut into pieces of length x cm each, where x is an integer. Find the maximum value of x.

(MTS 2021)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 34.

10 m 54 cm = 1054 cm 
11m 56cm = 1156 cm 
The maximum value of x is the HCF is 1054 and 1156. 
\(\therefore\) 1054              1156 
           
            diff = 102 
HCF will be 102 or a factor of 102
102 = 34 × 3
⇒ Maximum value of x = 34 cm
question_hi:
10 मीटर 54 सेमी और 11 मीटर 56 सेमी लंबाई वाले दो तारों को x सेमी लंबाई वाले टुकड़ों में काटा जाता है, जहाँ x एक पूर्णांक है। x का अधिकतम मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

(MTS 2021)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 34 है।

10 मी 54 सेमी = 1054 सेमी
11 मी 56 सेमी = 1156 सेमी 
x का अधिकतम मान है महत्तम समापवर्तक 1054 और 1156 है।
\(\therefore\) 1054              1156 
           
            अंतर = 102
महत्तम समापवर्तक 102 या 102 का कोई गुणज होगा।
102 = 34 × 3
⇒ x का अधिकतम मान = 34 सेमी

question:
A 15 m deep well with radius 2.8 m is dug, and the earth taken out from it is spread evenly to form a platform of breadth 8 m and height 1.5 m. What will be the length of the platform? (Take \(\pi\) = \(\frac{22}{7}\))

(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 30.8 m.

Volume of well = Volume of Platform

⇒ \(\frac{22}{7}\) \(\times\) 2.8 \(\times\) 2.8 \(\times\) 15 = l \(\times\) 8 \(\times\) 1.5
⇒ l = 30.8 m
question_hi:
2.8 मीटर त्रिज्या वाला, एक 15 मीटर गहरा कुंआ खोदा जाता है और इससे निकली मिट्टी को बराबर करके 8 मीटर चौड़ा और 1.5 मीटर ऊंचा एक चबूतरा बनाया जाता है। इस चबूतरे की लंबाई क्या है? (\(\pi\) = \(\frac{22}{7}\) मानें)

(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 30.8 मी है।

कुऍं का आयतन = प्‍लेटफॉर्म का आयतन

⇒ \(\frac{22}{7}\) \(\times\) 2.8 \(\times\) 2.8 \(\times\) 15 = l \(\times\) 8 \(\times\) 1.5
⇒ l = 30.8 मी

question:
A well with an inner radius of 3 m is dug 6 m deep. The soil taken out of it has been spread evenly all around it to a width of 2 m to form an embankment. The height (in m) of the embankment is:

(CGL MAINS 2020)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. \(3 \frac{3}{8}\).

Volume of soil taken out = Volume of soil of embankment 
⇒ \(\pi\) \(\times\) (3)2 \(\times\) 6 = \(\pi\) \(\times\) (52 - 32) \(\times\) h 
⇒ 54 = 16 \(\times\) h

question_hi:

(CGL MAINS 2020)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात \(3 \frac{3}{8}\) है।

निकाली गई मिट्टी का आयतन = तटबंध की मिट्टी का आयतन
⇒ \(\pi\) \(\times\) (3)2 \(\times\) 6 = \(\pi\) \(\times\) (52 - 32) \(\times\) h
